[[File:SkytunnelAoTC.png|thumb|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] chase through a skytunnel.]]
A '''skytunnel''', also known as a '''tram tunnel''', was a transportation tunnel that passed through a building, used for vehicular traffic on the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

Skytunnels were created when a building built by a powerful but ignorant corporation blocked an existing skyway of traffic. They were also used to direct traffic over high-security financial or governmental areas.
